critical_boundaries.context: Shrinking the stabilizer is neither by itself sufficient nor equivalent to shrinking A; uniqueness is exactly singleton E=A intersect Fix.
critical_boundaries.directed_context: An ordered transfer context alone fixes the same axis and its complement at axis level and both orientations on its own pair at D12 level; output=context requires a separate exact feasibility relation.
critical_boundaries.physical: No universal physical BRC law, physical probability, or physical direction preference is established.
critical_boundaries.s3: A genuine preexisting donor relation can give singleton Fix and unique donor even with full A.
critical_boundaries.s4_axis: A preexisting axis context leaves the complementary disjoint axis fixed and therefore remains noncanonical under full S4 equivariance.
critical_boundaries.scalar: Stabilizer filtering reproduces midpoint symmetry no-go but does not derive off-midpoint lower/upper selection; Stage-R order axioms remain additional structure.
critical_boundaries.straightness: Rank-one post-credit makes axis feasibility singleton but leaves orientation unresolved.
